name: gamenet_send_pkt0b_chat_message
description: GameNet::SendPkt0B_ChatMessage builds a dynamically-sized reliable chat packet with the local player key and raw message bytes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet packet-handler/HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433750 validates the strlen-derived allocation size of message length plus 12 bytes, full packet zero fill, packet type 0x0b, 16-bit packet size, local-player-key payload, 16-bit message length, exact positive-length byte copy without a required terminator, reliable send, and free.

The native chat-message packet smoke verifies non-empty and empty sends through zNetwork_SendPacketReliable, including reliable DirectPlay flags, packet size, local player key, message length, copied bytes, and zero-filled tail bytes.
